general_advice: Rest, stay hydrated, use saline nasal spray, and monitor symptoms. Typically resolves in 7-10 days.
Rest, fluids, isolate to prevent spread. Consult a physician if high fever persists or breathing becomes difficult.
Maintain oral rehydration with electrolyte solutions. Seek care if unable to keep fluids down for over 24 hours.
Rest in a quiet, dark room. Stay hydrated. Seek urgent evaluation if it is the 'worst headache of your life' or sudden onset.
Use humidifiers, rest, drink warm fluids. Seek medical evaluation if coughing up blood or short of breath.
Requires routine medical monitoring, low-sodium diet, lifestyle management, and adherence to prescribed medications.
